fichas.title: Self-Service Shops and Supermarket
fichas.summary: Self-service shops mainly sell food. Staff provide advice, assistance, and service, while butchery, cold meats, fruit, and vegetable sections are staffed. Goods are displayed in clearly organized packaging. The customer route begins at the basket stack or trolley park and ends at the checkout or packing table. The illustrated supermarket plan organizes food and non-food departments around the shopping route and checkout.

dimensions.ocr_raw:
RETAIL OUTLETS
Self-Service Shops

Self-service shops mostly sell food. The staff is responsible for advice, assistance and service. The butchery, cold meats, fruit and
vegetable sections are staffed. The goods are displayed clearly in
packaging according to type. It is important to design practical
routeing. The round trip starts at the basket stack or trolley park
and ends at the checkout or packing table. Wall shelves extend
up to reach height (top shelf is 1.80 m high and lowest 0.30 m
above the floor).
